gmd:name.gco:CharacterString: The granule for the generation of this terrain corrected product has been acquired as part of the ALOS mission. The ALOS satellite was launched on January 24, 2006. ALOS had a 46-day repeat cycle and operated until May 12, 2011.

gmd:abstract.gco:CharacterString: The terrain corrected product is derived from a single look complex SAR image. It is provided in Universal Transverse Mercator coordinates and is corrected for terrain by using a DEM.
